headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 11, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates pulled off a thrilling comeback to edge out the Milwaukee Brewers 7-6 in a closely contested game. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Brewers' offense with a grand slam and 6 RBIs. The Pirates also took down the Brewers 3-2 in another closely contested matchup, with Valdez leading the Brewers' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Zac Gallen of the Arizona Diamondbacks, who was placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Chris Martin of the Texas Rangers was also placed on the 15-day injured list with right shoulder impingement. Other notable injuries include Nick Lodolo of the Cincinnati Reds, William Kempner of the Miami Marlins, Brandon Woodruff of the Milwaukee Brewers, Mike Yastrzemski of the Atlanta Braves, Anthony Banda of the Minnesota Twins, and Nick Kurtz of the Athletics.

The Chicago White Sox made a trade with the Pittsburgh Pirates, sending LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pirates in exchange for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Minnesota Twins also made a trade, acquiring RHP Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for C Ryan Sprock and future considerations.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Brewers in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers 3-2 in a closely contested matchup. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Brewers' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Angels Fall Short in Twin Cities**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels dropped a 3-5 decision to the Minnesota Twins, marking their loss in the matchup. Royce Lewis led the Twins' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, while Joe Ryan pitched 6 strong innings for the Twins.

top_news.title: **Athletics Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox edged the Athletics 1-0, securing a narrow victory. Chase Meidroth led the Athletics' offense with 2 hits, 1 RBI, and a key double that scored a run.

top_news.title: Pittsburgh Pirates Finishes Off Milwaukee Brewers
top_news.summary: Pittsburgh Pirates wrapped up a 5-14 result over Milwaukee Brewers.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Orioles in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles dominated the Kansas City Royals 8-2, handing them a tough loss. Impact players for the Orioles included Gunnar Henderson and Lane Thomas, who both had standout performances.

top_news.title: **Gallen Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks right-hander Zac Gallen has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation, effective retroactive to July 9, 2026.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Infield with Shewmake Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have strengthened their lineup with the addition of shortstop Braden Shewmake, acquired in a trade with the Houston Astros. Shewmake joins the Brewers' roster, bringing his skills to the team.
